title: Record of the Western Regions of the Great Tang
subtitle: Travel observation, geography and the translation of knowledge
timeLabel: Tang composition context; transregional geographic record
shortSummary: The Record turns a pilgrim's travel experience into an account of geography, institutions, cities and religious sites.
curatorialDescription: It is both a travel record and an organised knowledge narrative; the museum separates observation, report and later interpretation.
Together with the Xuanzang, Kucha and Nalanda entries, it provides a research entry into the route.
researchNote: Specific editions, fascicles, translations, variants and distinctions among observation and report still need to be documented.
